definitions.explanation: A restaurant or shop that specializes in serving sushi.

examples.english: There is a sushi restaurant near the station.

examples.japanese: ⟦{誕生日|たんじょうび}→誕生日：02910_tanjoubi⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧{寿司屋|すしや}⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{食|た}べた→食べる：00396_taberu⟧。
examples.english: I ate at a high-end sushi restaurant on my birthday.

examples.japanese: ⟦あの→あの：00915_ano⟧{寿司屋|すしや}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{予約|よやく}→予約：01522_yoyaku⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{取|と}り→取る：00565_toru⟧にくいほど⟦{人気|にんき}→人気：01488_ninki⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: That sushi restaurant is so popular that it's hard to get a reservation.

notes:
{寿司屋|すしや} specifically refers to restaurants that specialize in sushi.

FORMS:
⟦{寿司|すし}→寿司：04946_sushi⟧ (sushi) + ⟦{屋|や}→〜屋：03096_ya⟧ (shop/restaurant suffix)

TYPES OF SUSHI RESTAURANTS:
- ⟦{回転|かいてん}{寿司|ずし}→回転寿司：11900_kaitenzushi⟧: conveyor belt sushi (casual, affordable)
- ⟦{高級|こうきゅう}→高級：08644_koukyuu⟧{寿司屋|すしや}: high-end sushi restaurant (often with a counter)
- ⟦{立|た}ち{食|ぐ}い→立ち食い：08290_tachigui⟧{寿司|ずし}: standing sushi bar (quick, informal)

CULTURAL NOTE:
At traditional {寿司屋|すしや}, customers sit at a counter (⟦カウンター→カウンター：10816_kauntaa⟧) facing the ⟦{板前|いたまえ}→板前：13118_itamae⟧ (sushi chef). Ordering ⟦おまかせ→おまかせ：08310_omakase⟧ (chef's choice) is common at higher-end establishments.

THE {屋|や} SUFFIX:
The same pattern forms many shop/restaurant names: ⟦{魚屋|さかなや}→魚屋：14642_sakanaya⟧ (fish shop), ⟦{花屋|はなや}→花屋：03136_hanaya⟧ (flower shop), ⟦{肉屋|にくや}→肉屋：15233_nikuya⟧ (butcher).
